primary_sources.finding: Bonaire test lowering explicitly moves value 31 into the operand of DS_ORDERED_COUNT. Reproduced locally with LLVM 18 llc -mcpu=bonaire -verify-machineinstrs.
Original pre-GFX10 ordered-add/swap intrinsic takes a value to add or swap.
Older opcode-summary population-count wording conflicts with explicit compiler operands. It is not sufficient evidence to discard captured ADDR or claim PS4 hardware behavior.
